verdict.rationale: Mintlify-hosted sites include a built-in, configurable in-product search bar. Results are ranked by per-chunk relevance scores that can be biased with `boost` multipliers, and admins can set result limits and product/version filters. Search queries also appear in analytics. Missing for 10: any evidence of typo/fuzzy tolerance, any evidence about search speed or latency, explicit confirmation that coverage spans the whole site, and independent or hands-on corroboration of search quality.
